description: Header file defining the ApplicationUwp class and related components for UWP platform integration in the starboard project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external references for managing application window, display modes, input events, and media protection.

classes.name: DisplayStatusWatcher
classes.description: Sealed ref class for monitoring display status changes, manages a device watcher for display status updates.

classes.name: ApplicationUwp
classes.description: Main application class for UWP platform, manages window creation, display modes, input events, and media protection features.

methods.name: CreateWatcher
methods.description: Creates a device watcher for display status monitoring.

methods.name: IsWatcherStarted
methods.description: Checks if the display status watcher has been started.

methods.name: StopWatcher
methods.description: Stops the display status watcher.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApplicationUwp.

methods.name: CreateWindowForUWP
methods.description: Creates a window with specified options for UWP.

methods.name: GetVisibleAreaSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the visible area or maximum display size if window not instantiated.

methods.name: DestroyWindow
methods.description: Destroys the specified window.

methods.name: DispatchStart
methods.description: Dispatches a start event with timestamp.

methods.name: SetCommandLine
methods.description: Sets command line arguments for the application.

methods.name: DispatchAndDelete
methods.description: Dispatches an event and deletes it.

methods.name: GetCoreWindow
methods.description: Returns the current CoreWindow object.

methods.name: GetDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the dispatcher associated with the CoreWindow.

methods.name: GetTransportControls
methods.description: Returns the media transport controls.

methods.name: SetCoreWindow
methods.description: Sets the CoreWindow and updates related dispatcher and transport controls.

methods.name: OnKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events from the CoreWindow.

methods.name: Inject
methods.description: Injects an event into the application.

methods.name: InjectKeypress
methods.description: Injects a keypress event.

methods.name: SetStartLink
methods.description: Sets the start link URL.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieves localized string with fallback.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayPreferredMode
methods.description: Updates the preferred display mode.

methods.name: IsHdrSupported
methods.description: Checks if HDR is supported.

methods.name: GetRefreshRate
methods.description: Returns the current display refresh rate.

methods.name: GetPreferredModeHdr
methods.description: Returns the preferred HDR display mode.

methods.name: GetPreferredModeHdmi
methods.description: Returns the preferred HDMI display mode.

methods.name: IsHdcpOn
methods.description: Checks if HDCP is enabled.

methods.name: TurnOnHdcp
methods.description: Enables HDCP protection.

methods.name: TurnOffHdcp
methods.description: Disables HDCP protection.

methods.name: SetOutputProtection
methods.description: Enables or disables output protection.
